cohort.base_algorithm: Exact original numeric generation algorithm, with only seed, version and participant-ID literal changed; original source/data/model are not modified.
cohort.target_definition: Original next-day simulated custom0-10 self-report category: low<4, moderate4<=x<7, high>=7. It is not a KSS/SP label.

sleep_allocation.segments: N+1 equal-duration sleep segments totalingTST separated byN equal wake intervals totalingWASO; no wake intervals ifN==0.
sleep_allocation.chronology: Main opportunity must lie within the 24h window ending at cutoff; negative budgets, impossible chronology or overlapping sleep intervals abort generation. No deletion, seed search or silent repair.

nap.proposed_duration_minutes: Uniform(10,40) drawn each day independently of latent states
nap.duration: If Bernoulli attempt and min(proposed_duration,free_budget,available_time_window)>=10minutes, use that minimum; otherwise confirmed synthetic no-nap with count0 and duration0.
nap.sleep_latency_and_waso: Not modelled for nap; the allocated interval is entirely asleep.
nap.base_target_process: Unchanged. The original fatigue evolution uses main sleep only; naps do not cause recovery in the target-generating process.

derived_sleep.total_sleep_last_24h_hours: Sum of all nonoverlapping main+nap sleep-segment intersections with[cutoff-24h,cutoff).
derived_sleep.nap_sleep_minutes_last_24h: Sum nap-segment intersections with the same24h window.
derived_sleep.time_since_last_sleep_hours: cutoff minus most recent completed sleep-segment end; an allocated nap resets this value.
derived_sleep.sleep_target_role: Fixed configured goal metadata, not biological need and not a predictor.
derived_sleep.prior_3day_sleep_shortfall_hours: sum(max(0,8-total_sleep_last_24h_hours[d])) for same participant daysd=t-3,t-2,t-1; three nonoverlapping windows; not clinically validated sleep debt.

questionnaire_proxies.restrictions: Use independent extension RNG; no rescaling of observed fatigue, no use of next-day states/labels, no threshold/noise tuning after seeing generated data or results. Hidden states are audit-only and never predictors.

feature_contract.baseline: Exact original26numeric feature names and order from original task_config.json.
feature_contract.metadata_not_predictors: All identifiers/timestamps/provenance/constants/raw latent states/target columns/episode details and nap counts.

interpretation: Fresh synthetic feature-extension experiment. It is not a NASA dataset, clinical validation, reconstruction of actual missing measurements, or direct score comparison against the old cohort. Sleep allocations are alternate representations of existing aggregates; the new ordinal proxies may improve prediction merely by revealing the simulator's current latent state.
